notes: Label at the top reads HANIFIELD (no suffix visible in strip; Street assumed). Hanifield's north edge is cut off by the plate edge: centre taken about 100 px north of the south edge, near the solid water-pipe line; Jerome crossing sits at the very top of the plate. Jerome and Florida appear to continue north of Hanifield to the plate edge. A short line with a hydrant and a lot line going north near (3285,250) may be another street off Hanifield's north side (text GEO...), not picked. Hoffner Avenue is drawn as a narrow strip here (25 ft west of Sylvan, 30 ft between Sylvan and Edgewood, 55 ft east of Edgewood); y taken at the middle of the drawn strip. Powers Street's south edge is off the plate: centre y estimated 75 px south of its north edge (y 7132); whether Sylvan and Edgewood continue south of Powers cannot be seen (Edgewood's sewer dashes do continue). Sylvan and Edgewood each exist as a short piece south of Colerain and a long piece from Hoffner to Powers, nothing between (Byron Kirby Heirs land, creek). Kearsarge Avenue's crossing with the north-south street at x about 1815 is outside the 1940 limit. | Hanfield is printed 'HANIFIELD'-like lettering; recorded as Hanfield Street. Hanfield is 60 ft wide and its north edge is at or just beyond the plate cut; the solid line running inside it is the 6 in. water pipe, not an edge; centres taken 90 px north of the south lot line. Jerome/Hanfield: no continuation of Jerome north of Hanfield visible (plate top), kind uncertain. '?' at 3327,268: a narrow (about 30 ft) stub going north from Hanfield in a notch of the plate, lettered 'GEO...' (cut off); may be an alley or not a street. Florida continues north of Hanfield in a plate notch. Powers Street: only the north edge (y about 7130) is on the plate; a continuous line at y about 7185 is taken as the plate border / approximate centre, so y of the two Powers crossings is uncertain by about 25 px; whether Sylvan and Edgewood continue south is off the plate. No street crossings between the creek (y 1900) and Hoffner Avenue inside the strip: Wesleyan-side Kirby Heirs tract and the West Branch only. The north-south avenue west of the strip (centre x about 1830) and its crossings with Wolcott and Kearsarge lie outside x 1940.
